instruction.text: Select the words with a possessive -s ending.

atoms.a: Ravi has three toy animals. The giraffe’s neck makes it taller than the other animals. The elephant’s trunk is up in the air. The tiger’s stripes are black and orange.
atoms.b: Ravi has three toy animals. The ((giraffe’s)) neck makes it taller than the other animals. The ((elephant’s)) trunk is up in the air. The ((tiger’s)) stripes are black and orange.

wrong.text: Remember, you can also find the possessives by looking for apostrophes.

instruction.text: Select the words with a possessive -s ending.

atoms.a: It is a summer day and the sun’s rays are shining through the green leaves. The tree’s branches are twisted and reach high into the clouds.
atoms.b: It is a summer day and the ((sun’s)) rays are shining through the green leaves. The ((tree’s)) branches are twisted and reach high into the clouds.

wrong.text: Remember, you can also find the possessives by looking for apostrophes.

instruction.text: Select all the plural nouns in the text.

atoms.a: The drummer’s hands have to move quickly to set the right tempo for the rest of the band members. The guitarists and singer rely on her.
atoms.b: The drummer’s ((hands)) have to move quickly to set the right tempo for the rest of the band ((members)). The ((guitarists)) and singer rely on her.

instruction.text: Select all the plural nouns in the text.

hint.text: There is also an irregular plural noun in this text that does not have an -s ending. Can you find it?

atoms.a: The children have used the buckets and spades to build a massive sand castle. The castle’s walls are not very stable though, and the waves will soon knock it over.
atoms.b: The ((children)) have used the ((buckets)) and ((spades)) to build a massive sand castle. The castle’s ((walls)) are not very stable though, and the ((waves)) will soon knock it over.
